paragraphs.context: Very clever were some of their productions
paragraphs.mainIdea: The girls were not rich, so they made their own things for the play. Some of them were very clever.
paragraphs.simple: The kind acts and ceremonies of the morning took so much time that the rest of the day was used to get ready for the evening party. The girls were still too young to go to the theatre often, and not rich enough to pay much for plays at home. So they used their wits. Need is the mother of invention, and they made everything they needed. Some of their work was very clever: guitars made of pasteboard, old lamps made from old-style butter-boats covered with silver paper, rich robes of old cotton shining with tin spangles from a pickle factory, and armor covered with the same useful diamond-shaped pieces. These were left in sheets when the lids of tin preserve-pots were cut out. The furniture was used to being turned upside down, and the big bedroom was the place of many innocent games.

sentences.context: Being still too young to go often to the theatre
sentences.simple: The girls were still too young to go to the theatre often, and they were not rich enough to pay for private plays, so they used their wits.
sentences.grammar: 'Being still too young...' is a participle phrase. It gives the reason for what the girls did next.
